# TextureCoords <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TextureCoords:Void texture:Int32, coords:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `texture` | In | Int32 | required | The texture. |
| `coords` | In | Int32 | required | 0 or 1. |

## Description

Chooses which set of texture coordinates of the mesh the texture reads: 0 for the first set, 1 for the second.

## Differences

* Only these two sets exist, the call sets or clears the same switch as the flag 65536 of LoadTexture and CreateTexture.
